label: hexInSwapsRedBlue: a picked hex color reaches the Halo layer with red and blue swapped
find: init(hex: HexColor) { self.init(bytes: hex.red, hex.green, hex.blue) }
replace: init(hex: HexColor) { self.init(bytes: hex.blue, hex.green, hex.red) }

label: hexOutSwapsRedGreen: a Halo layer color shows in the color row with red and green swapped
